links.comparator_used: standard-of-care double reading by two radiologists
links.outcome: screen-detected breast cancer within 3 months / cancer detection rate
links.effect: double reading by one radiologist plus AI: 261 [0·5%] detected cases vs 250 [0·4%] with double reading by two radiologists; relative proportion 1·04 [95% CI 1·00-1·09]
links.quote: Replacing one radiologist with AI for independent reading of screening mammograms resulted in a 4% higher non-inferior cancer detection rate compared with radiologist double reading.

design_hint: Replacing one radiologist with AI as independent reader (reader workflow configuration)
